limits: All cell summaries are descriptive; no significance, tolerance or causal timing attribution.
Differences of cell means are supplementary; frozen blockwise contrasts and every raw row retained.
k0 S/L requests differ in length; their L-S contrast is not a matched probe contrast.
PID I/O covers client launch/teardown envelope, not decode-only or expert-only reads.
Group memory peaks are not per-request peaks or a de-duplicated physical RAM union.
Four service launches per cell do not establish temporal iid independence.
